"""Turn post titles into URL slugs."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unicodedata

MAX_LENGTH = 50
STOP_WORDS = frozenset(
    "a an and are as at be but by for from in into is it of on or than that the to with".split()
)


def slugify(title: str, sep: str = "-") -> str:
    """Lowercase the title and join its runs of letters and digits with sep."""
    folded = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", folded.lower())
    kept = [word for word in words if word not in STOP_WORDS] or words
    return sep.join(kept)[:MAX_LENGTH].rstrip(sep)


def slug_path(titles: list[str]) -> str:
    """Slugify each title and join the slugs with '/'."""
    return "/".join(slugify(title) for title in titles)


def unique_slug(title: str, existing: set[str]) -> str:
    """A slug for title that is not in existing, appending -2, -3, and so on."""
    base = slugify(title)
    slug, n = base, 2
    while slug in existing:
        slug = f"{base}-{n}"
        n += 1
    return slug
